entries.headline: V4.0.0 goes live today at 18:00 JST
entries.body: All 20 V4 modules are in. Distribution starts today at 18:00 JST on the download page and through Corvus self-update.
items: 20 modules (Chronos Anchor, Dimensional Mirror, Resonance Rail, Acoustic Turret, Glitch Strider and more)
The changelog is published at the same moment
Corvus offers the update on launch

entries.headline: The V4 update
entries.body: The next major update, with 20 modules planned. It has an announcement page of its own.
